# devopser_workspace (Resource)

An Infrastructure Control workspace (tfe_workspace).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "devopser_github_app_installation" "gh" {
  name = "my-github-org"
}

resource "devopser_workspace" "network" {
  name              = "network"
  auto_apply        = true
  queue_all_runs    = false
  working_directory = "network"
  terraform_version = "1.9.4"

  vcs_repo {
    identifier                 = "my-github-org/infrastructure"
    branch                     = "main"
    github_app_installation_id = data.devopser_github_app_installation.gh.id
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Workspace name, unique in the organization.

### Optional

- `auto_apply` (Boolean) Apply successful plans without a confirmation.
- `auto_apply_run_trigger` (Boolean) Accepted for tfe compatibility. Run triggers are not supported yet.
- `aws_connection_id` (String) The AWS connection runs use. DevOpser-only; tfe workspaces used env credentials.
- `force_delete` (Boolean) Delete even while the state manages resources (they stay in AWS).
- `organization` (String) Accepted for tfe compatibility and ignored.
- `project_id` (String) Accepted for tfe compatibility and ignored: DevOpser has no projects.
- `queue_all_runs` (Boolean) Accepted for tfe compatibility. Creating a workspace never queues a run.
- `terraform_version` (String) Mapped to the workspace's OpenTofu version; Terraform versions use the nearest supported OpenTofu.
- `vcs_repo` (Block, Optional) The GitHub repository runs check out. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--vcs_repo))
- `working_directory` (String) Directory in the repository that runs execute in.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The workspace id.

<a id="nestedblock--vcs_repo"></a>
### Nested Schema for `vcs_repo`

Optional:

- `branch` (String) Branch to run from; the default branch when empty.
- `github_app_installation_id` (String) From devopser_github_app_installation. Accepted for tfe compatibility; the organization's installation is used.
- `identifier` (String) owner/repo
- `ingress_submodules` (Boolean) Check out git submodules too.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# By id or by name.
tofu import devopser_workspace.network 42
tofu import devopser_workspace.network network
```
